title: How How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Works and How to Deploy It Today
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and digital downloads with automated crypto delivery — no platform middleman, no payout delays, no geographic filter.

content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, Venezuela, or Pakistan, digital creators face significant hurdles when trying to sell their products online due to restrictions from platforms like Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. This infrastructure problem can be solved with a sovereign digital commerce stack, allowing creators to own their store, process payments in crypto, and deliver products instantly, without relying on third-party platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The sovereignty of the digital commerce stack lies in its ability to operate independently of traditional payment platforms. By utilizing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, creators can sell their digital products without the fear of platform restrictions or fees. This infrastructure is particularly useful for creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, who can now reach a global audience without limitations.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need to have a clear understanding of your product offerings, target audience, and the crypto payment system you will be using. You should also have a basic understanding of how to set up a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and how to configure a backend logic service like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Additionally, you will need to set up a NOWPayments account to enable crypto payment processing.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves configuring your hosting service to work with your backend logic service, and integrating NOWPayments to enable crypto payment processing. You will also need to set up a system for automatic product delivery, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, to ensure that customers receive their products instantly after payment. This pipeline is crucial in ensuring a seamless customer experience and building trust with your audience.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks empower creators to own their stores and process payments in crypto.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live with your sovereign digital commerce stack. The first transaction is a significant milestone, as it validates the effectiveness of your infrastructure. With NOWPayments, you can process payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, with a low fee of 0.5% per transaction. This flexibility and cost-effectiveness make it an ideal solution for digital creators looking to expand their reach and revenue streams.

You may also need to expand your product offerings, or explore new markets and audiences.
